name: Request membership in the Heroes' Guild

evidence.note: Quest and 55-point gates. Skill requirements apply to the relevant later stages.

name: Buy fishing ingredients and a conditional combat reserve

evidence.note: Approximate member-account GE budget. Food reserve covers a successful Ice Queen fight and Phoenix-branch Grip encounter.

name: Ask Gerrant for blamish snail slime

evidence.note: Gerrant supplies an untradeable sample for the oily fishing rod after Heroes' Quest begins.

name: Mix blamish oil and coat the fishing rod

evidence.note: Gerrant supplies untradeable slime; mix it with an unfinished harralander potion for 80 Herblore XP, then coat the rod.

name: Catch a raw lava eel in Taverley Dungeon

evidence.note: Requires oily rod, bait and level 53 Fishing (boostable). A successful raw lava eel catch pays 60 Fishing XP.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Catch one raw lava eel with the oily fishing rod and the modelled bait allocation.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use additional bait from the reserve and adjust fishing time, XP and item counts before proceeding.

name: Cook the caught lava eel on a fire

evidence.note: Light a fire with a log and tinderbox; a successful eel cook grants 30 Cooking XP. Burning risk is a conditional outcome.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Successfully cook a lava eel without burning it.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Catch another eel and restock logs and bait; update incidental XP and the route after a failure.

name: Defeat the Ice Queen and take her gloves

evidence.note: Dig through the White Wolf Mountain rocks and defeat the level-111 Ice Queen. This step may be skipped when ice gloves were obtained during the Mountain Dwarf route.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Ice Queen and pick up ice gloves using at most six lobsters.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Restock and retry; player combat XP and food usage are conditional.

name: Defeat the Entrana firebird while wearing ice gloves

evidence.note: Use the Entrana ferry's restricted-equipment gate; do this before acquiring the Black Arm disguise if possible. The ice gloves protect from the fiery feather.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the firebird and claim one fire feather with ice gloves equipped.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Return with a compatible loadout and gloves, then retry; combat XP depends on method.

name: Buy black armour for the Black Arm route

evidence.note: Buy after the Entrana firebird to avoid blocking the ferry with armour. Three pieces required for the mansion disguise.

name: Receive the Black Arm assignment from Katrine

evidence.note: The existing Shield of Arrav gang flag chooses the correct gang route.

name: Enter Grip's mansion and retrieve the thieves' armband

evidence.note: Wear all three armour pieces, gain Grip's key and reach his chest while a cooperating Phoenix Gang player handles Grip. Assistance timing is conditional; source helper candidate points identify mansion steps.

planned_outcome.success_condition: An available Phoenix Gang partner assists the infiltration and Grip's key and armband are obtained.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Find an eligible opposite-gang helper, arrange the encounter and replan the time before proceeding.

name: Ask Straven about the Master Thieves' armband

evidence.note: Existing Phoenix Gang flag selects the alternate Heroes' Quest route.

name: Help the Black Arm partner and recover the armband

evidence.note: Coordinate with a Black Arm player at Brimhaven mansion, take the secret approach and defeat Grip when exposed. Conditional food and combat XP.

planned_outcome.success_condition: An opposite-gang helper grants access and Grip is defeated; retrieve the armband without exceeding four lobsters.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Coordinate with another eligible Black Arm helper; restock and retry on observed fight progress.

name: Hand the eel, armband and fire feather to Achietties

evidence.note: Completion pays 1 quest point and twelve fixed XP awards. Mining XP 2,575 differs from the pinned Quest Helper's 2,275; independent gameplay confirmation pending.

name: Hear King Vargas's request

evidence.note: Prerequisite quests gate the conversation. Woodcutting, Farming, Mining and Smithing thresholds in helper are alternative favour tasks, not universal quest start gates.

name: Buy royal courting and diplomatic supplies

evidence.note: Approximate trade-enabled budget for iron bar, log, rake and plain gold ring.

name: Buy a bronze axe for maple favour

evidence.note: Budgeted Grand Exchange acquisition for an optional kingdom-favour route; prices and availability should be checked live.

name: Buy a bronze pickaxe for coal favour

evidence.note: Budgeted Grand Exchange acquisition for an optional kingdom-favour route; prices and availability should be checked live.

name: Buy a lobster pot for fishing favour

evidence.note: Budgeted Grand Exchange acquisition for an optional kingdom-favour route; prices and availability should be checked live.

name: Buy a shortbow for courting Astrid

evidence.note: Alternative to the cake for Prince Brand; an existing shortbow also works.

name: Buy chocolate cake for courting Brand

evidence.note: Alternate Prince Brand route; bought chocolate cake is consumed as a gift.

name: Buy flowers from the flower girl

evidence.note: Island flower shop sells a bouquet for courting; no special Farming route is necessary.

name: Court Princess Astrid with flowers, a bow and a ring

evidence.note: The Astrid marriage route gifts flowers and a bow, then proposes with a common ring.

name: Court Prince Brand with flowers, cake and a ring

evidence.note: The Brand marriage route gifts flowers and a chocolate cake, then proposes with a common ring.

name: Ask Queen Sigrid about joining Miscellania

evidence.note: First Etceteria diplomatic visit.

name: Deliver the Queen's request to Vargas

evidence.note: Vargas requests diplomatic follow-up and an acceptable anthem.

name: Ask Prince Brand for the anthem

evidence.note: The draft song needs advisor revision.

name: Ask Advisor Ghrim to revise the anthem

evidence.note: Present Brand's anthem for a diplomatically acceptable version.

name: Return to Sigrid with revised terms

evidence.note: Second Etceteria diplomatic visit, pending a written treaty.

name: Commission a giant nib from Derrik

evidence.note: Derrik the smith shapes the nib from an iron bar.

name: Put a log and giant nib together as a pen

evidence.note: Pen construction is an item combination, not a general-purpose training action.

name: Give the giant pen to Vargas for the treaty

evidence.note: Vargas can now sign the terms for Queen Sigrid.

name: Bring the completed treaty to Sigrid

evidence.note: Queen Sigrid accepts the diplomatic treaty.

name: Rake Miscellania weeds until approval is at least 75 percent

evidence.note: Selected repeatable favour method: clearing flax-field weeds. The exact 75% threshold, action timing and incidental XP need live verification; this is not a universal starting skill gate.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Check the kingdom approval indicator and continue raking until it reaches at least 75 percent.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue the favour activity and correct timing or required levels before the final Vargas visit.

name: Buy and offer flowers to gain at least 75 percent approval

evidence.note: Optional fast, click-intensive favour route. A conservative 2500-coin budget is modeled; actual coin use, percentage chance and time need live review.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Check kingdom approval and continue this method until approval is at least 75 percent.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue the favour method, or switch to another eligible favour method and revise the duration estimate.

name: Chop maple trees to gain at least 75 percent approval

evidence.note: Woodcutting level 45 is needed only for the maple-tree method, not for the quest as a whole; actual timing depends on log rates.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Check kingdom approval and continue this method until approval is at least 75 percent.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue the favour method, or switch to another eligible favour method and revise the duration estimate.

name: Mine coal to gain at least 75 percent approval

evidence.note: Mining level 35 for coal is cited by the current OSRS quest guide; original release notes and kingdom task tables differ at 30. Verify game build and timing.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Check kingdom approval and continue this method until approval is at least 75 percent.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue the favour method, or switch to another eligible favour method and revise the duration estimate.

name: Fish from Miscellania docks to gain at least 75 percent approval

evidence.note: Fishing level 35 is one alternative approval route. Use a lobster pot by the docks, checking every fish catch and the approval indicator.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Check kingdom approval and continue this method until approval is at least 75 percent.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue the favour method, or switch to another eligible favour method and revise the duration estimate.

name: Accept the regency from King Vargas

evidence.note: Kingdom management opens after courtship, the treaty and sufficient favour. No immediate fixed XP reward.
